messages:
sara: Opened a PR to add HSM attestation + token provisioning steps for private/VPC installs behind NAT. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/629 — need wording + snippets.
liam: Quick pass — should we include a minimal PKCS#11 example inline or point to examples directory? I think both.
sara: Included both. Inline snippet for quick copy and pointer to examples/onprem/hsm-pkcs11.conf for full context. Snippet below:
```conf
pkcs11_module = /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so
token_label = "redwood-hsm"
slot = 0
pin_env = HSM_PIN
```
tony: Nice. Add note about time sync and SEV/TPM expectations for vendor HSMs. Also call out common filesystem/permission pitfalls — HSM device nodes must be readable by hsm group.
docs-bot: Placeholder crosslink added: docs/onprem/hsm-integration.md#pkcs11-example (update anchor if document moves).
deploy-bot: CI job preflight-hsm-3c created — it will run a quick parse and a mock PKCS#11 probe in a container. CI fails if module path missing or config malformed.
liam: Please add troubleshooting for common errors: 'CKR_TOKEN_NOT_PRESENT' (check token-label, slot), 'CKR_PIN_INCORRECT' (verify HSM_PIN), and permission fixes: `chown root:hsm /dev/char* && chmod 660 /dev/char*`.
sara: Added troubleshooting bullets and a short installer checklist entry (ensure NAT hairpinning or correct bastion routing for HSM access in isolated networks). Trimmed step numbers to match quickstart.
liam: Tiny wording nit fixed, approved. Merge on green. :white_check_mark:
